questions.q: What does Paul marvel at about the Galatians?
options: They are so quickly turning to a different good news
They refused to receive his messengers
They sent no gift to Jerusalem

Your offspring will be like the stars
I will give you this land

options: Our tutor to bring us to Christ

questions.answer: having become a curse for us

Abraham believed God
Why then is there the law?
Abraham's offspring and heirs by promise

items: Restore someone caught in a fault
